mapper.insert: insert into user (openid, nickname, real_name, student_no, student_card_img, phone, credit_score, role, status, avatar, create_time, update_time) values (#{openid}, #{nickname}, #{realName}, #{studentNo}, #{studentCardImg}, #{phone}, #{creditScore}, #{role}, #{status}, #{avatar}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.sql: u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.phone, u.student_no studentNo, u.role, u.status, u.credit_score creditScore, u.create_time createTime, (select count(*) from review r where r.to_user_id = u.id and r.star >= 4) goodReviewCount, (select count(*) from review r where r.to_user_id = u.id and r.star <= 2) badReviewCount
